row.evidence: Easy LMS's pricing page offers Basic and Advanced flat-fee plans with SSO as a paid add-on and only an "API to add participants"; its help centre documents OpenID Connect SSO with JIT academy sign-up and returns "We couldn't find any articles for: scim".
row.notes: Unchanged from June: no SCIM. Flat-fee pricing, unlimited participants: Basic $80/mo or $800/yr, Advanced $230/mo or $2,300/yr (EUR 70/700 and 200/2,000); per-user fields null. June's 'Basic $80/mo' was the monthly price; annual is $800/yr (2 months free). SSO (OpenID Connect for participants: Entra ID, Okta, Auth0, Cognito) is an add-on on either plan, shown as $60/mo ($720/yr) in the price calculator but '$55' in the add-on list. SSO auto-adds participants to the academy on first login (JIT); group assignment is manual, by Excel import or via the API. The API (Advanced only) can only add participants to exams, courses and academies; there is no list, update or delete endpoint and no admin API.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: SSO only as a paid add-on. API and webhooks are listed only for Advanced.

scim.notes: Absence: no SCIM or provisioning on the pricing page, the help-centre sitemap or the API articles; help-centre search for 'scim' and 'provisioning' returns no articles.

auth.notes: Exam/academy calls take an apikey field; course call uses an X-Api-Key header generated under My account > Advanced setup > API access.

capabilities.notes: The overview lists five calls, all 'add participant' variants; academy calls can add the participant to groups. False values are from that complete list.

endpoints.purpose: Add participant to exam and send invite
Add participant to exam without invite
Add participant to academy (and groups) and send invite
Add participant to academy (and groups) without invite

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks exist on Advanced (e.g. exam webhook payload); no user lifecycle events documented.

limitations.text: API only adds participants; deletion is manual in the Participants page and is permanent.

okta.notes: Okta named as a supported OpenID Connect SSO provider; no catalogue app checked.

entra.notes: Configured as a custom Web app registration in Entra (OIDC), not a gallery app.

fallbacks.notes: Excel import of users into academy groups.
